scientific_integrity: The all-length statement is based on the displayed parity obstruction, exact factor decimation, a complete finite base and induction; finite tests are supportive, not a substitute for proof. Novelty comparisons identify a material risk from the inaccessible full text of Allouche and Bousquet-Mélou (1994).
scientific_limitations: Only the regular paperfolding sequence or its bit-complement is treated; no theorem for arbitrary folding instructions, complete return-time distributions, or independent audit is asserted.
title: Initial non-repetitive complexity of the regular paperfolding word
